handoff: Approve, 0 blocking. Spawning-tier preload bounds every untimed Bun.spawnSync (15s, SIGKILL): harness sh(), in-process gitSync/ps, direct test calls; fixture tests prove stuck calls fail named and the run continues. Unit tier, typecheck, touched integration files green. Minor: non-spawn blocks uncut; grandchildren orphaned on timeout.

findings.title: Non-spawn blocks are still uncut
findings.detail:
A blocking synchronous read (reproduce's FIFO row) or a busy loop still cannot be cut by bun test's per-test timeout, so 'the integration tier never hangs' holds for sync spawns only. The observed CI hang was a sync spawn.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: A tier-level watchdog that names running files when output stops, in a later story if it recurs.

findings.title: Timeout kills only the direct child
findings.detail:
Bun.spawnSync's timeout SIGKILLs the child, not its process group; a grandchild (e.g. a git alias's sleep) is orphaned until it exits. Does not block the test (output goes through temp files or the pipe returns), only leaks a process.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Accept; or run stuck-prone calls through spawnBounded's process-group kill.
